name: Smartsheet
label: Smartsheet API 2.0
description: Smartsheet API 2.0 via OfficialApiNode (nodes/smartsheet/api_spec.json). Official Smartsheet API 2.0. Enterprise admins may block tokens. Developer agreement applies. Official docs: https://developers.smartsheet.com/api/smartsheet. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data} or {error}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Smartsheet official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"row_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'row_create', 'row_update', 'row_delete', 'sheet_create', 'sheet_copy', 'sheet_get', 'folder_create', 'folder_copy', 'workspace_copy', 'comment_create', 'user_add', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'row_create'.

schema.label: sheetId
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `sheetId` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: toBottom
schema.description: row_create toBottom. true appends at the bottom (typical).

schema.label: cells
schema.description: row_create / row_update cells. Official [{columnId, value}]. Example: [{"columnId":123,"value":"Done"}].

schema.label: id
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `id` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: ids
schema.description: row_delete query ids — comma-separated row ids.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `name` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: columns
schema.description: sheet_create columns. Official [{title, type}]. type: TEXT_NUMBER | DATE | CHECKBOX | PICKLIST.

schema.label: destinationType
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `destinationType` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: destinationId
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `destinationId` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: newName
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `newName` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: folderId
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `folderId` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: workspaceId
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `workspaceId` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: rowId
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `rowId` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: text
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `text` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `email` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: admin
schema.description: user_add admin flag.

schema.label: licensedSheetCreator
schema.description: user_add licensedSheetCreator. Required by Smartsheet on user_add.

schema.label: Discussion Id
schema.description: Discussion id for comment_create (POST /sheets/{sheetId}/discussions/{discussionId}/comments). Example: '123456'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: row_create, row_update, row_delete, sheet_create, sheet_copy, sheet_get, folder_create, folder_copy, workspace_copy, comment_create, user_add, listen. Default: row_create. Example: row_create.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey access_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
